<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 10"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Azure Fins](/Feats.aspx?ID=4363) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=12" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm](/Sources.aspx?ID=209) pg. 81

**Archetype** [Worm Caller](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=208)

**Prerequisites**
[Worm Caller Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=4357)

</column>

---

When submerged in water or another liquid, you form small fin-like arms along your body, granting you far greater maneuverability while swimming. You gain a swim Speed equal to your land Speed. Furthermore, while swimming on the surface of a liquid, you can [Leap](/Actions.aspx?ID=81) out of the liquid and do not fall until the end of your turn, allowing you to spend the rest of the turn above the surface.

<title level="2">Azure Fins leads to...</title>
[Call the Worm](/Feats.aspx?ID=4369)
